results.title: Passive packaging performance, not necessarily active real-time alerting
results.closest_fact_claim: The company uses a reusable high-performance equipment system claiming '100% monitoring of interior temperature' for all shipments, with autonomous temperature maintenance for a minimum of 120 hours -- part of a reuse model that reports 375 tonnes of CO2 reduction and 10,166 fewer boxes destroyed compared to single-use packaging.

results.title: Four countries, three regulatory regimes, one claimed monitoring standard
results.closest_fact_claim: The company operates logistics centers in Spain (Madrid-Barcelona), the UK (York), the USA (Indianapolis), and Germany (Darmstadt), with solutions reaching Europe, North America, and South-east Asia.
